description: Invite ONE person to this tenant and to the connected products with ONE email (admins only; ticket 86a7b144). Creates the DelegAIze account (or reuses an existing one), makes it a member of THIS tenant and stores the role per product; the products take account, organisation and role from DelegAIze at sign-in. The email contains a link to set the password (valid 24 h; only for a new or unconfirmed account) and a link to every product granted. Required: email. Optional: name, role (DelegAIze role: admin|planner|viewer|caller, default planner), product_roles (object product → admin|planner|viewer, e.g. {"nodem": "admin", "tenderaize": "planner"}; omitted = every product with the DelegAIze role). Products: nodem, tenderaize, bookaize, supportaize, ernteapp, verain, complaiance, coachaize. Calling again for the same address re-sends the email (with a fresh link if the password is still unset) and updates the product roles. Fails without sending anything if the account already belongs to another tenant.

name.description: Display name of the invited person

product_roles.description: Role per product (admin, planner, viewer); omitted = DelegAIze role everywhere

role.description: DelegAIze role: admin, planner (default), viewer or caller

tenant_id.description: Optional safety check: the tenant the invitation is meant for. If it is not the tenant this call acts in (e.g. switch to a sub-account missing or revoked), nothing is sent.

name: delegaize_user_invite
